evidence.decision: After the 1927 Heisenberg Activity is relinked to the existing Weimar Republic, preserve polity UUID 5dee6535-9839-4c8b-8de5-b7519d41801d for the 1933-1945 German state and bound its preferred names to that period. Normalize the existing Federal Republic of Germany UUID to an official-state Korean display that remains valid after 1990 rather than the period-specific shorthand West Germany.
evidence.identity_rule: Weimar Republic (1918-1933), German Reich under National Socialism (1933-1945), and Federal Republic of Germany (since 1949) remain separate ATLAS identities under the reviewed rupture/state-formation model. Nazi Germany is not created as a separate territorial polity from the 1933-1945 German Reich.
